'''Polke''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Erisson Flask]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Silver Bolt]]''.
